layers.process: You need your passport to travel between Peninsular Malaysia and Sarawak, even though the trip stays inside Malaysia. East Malaysia (Sabah and Sarawak) has its own entry checks.

zone-requirements.note: Sabah and Sarawak keep their own immigration powers under Part VII of Malaysia's Immigration Act 1959/63 (the Act wasn't read on an official page).

laws.rule: Sabah and Sarawak keep their own immigration control under the Immigration Act 1959/63: travelling between the Peninsula, Sabah and Sarawak needs a valid passport (no visa), and you clear immigration again on arrival.
